title: OMCA plan registry, version 1
description: The registry .omca/state/boulder.json. It describes what the writer emits, which is exactly the keys version, plans and bindings. A reader ignores unknown keys and reads a missing plans or bindings as empty, so no level forbids additional properties.

version.description: Always written first by the writer. A file without it reads as version 1.

plans.description: Registered plans by plan name. A plan name is 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen, starting with a letter or digit, and is not a Windows device name or a name ending in a dot.

started_at.description: UTC at seconds precision when the plan was first registered, such as 2026-10-02T10:00:00Z.

session_ids.description: Every session that registered the plan, in order.

worktree_path.description: Path of the worktree the plan runs in. Absent when the plan has none.

bindings.description: The plan each session is bound to, by session id.

bound_at.description: Epoch seconds when the session was bound.
